title: Vectra
description: Privacy-focused AI coding agent for VS Code with local and cloud models.
subtitle: A privacy-first, model-agnostic AI agent platform for VS Code and the web: local GGUF and Ollama models or cloud providers behind one interface, typed and searchable tools, risk-scoped subagents, and human approval for every change.
contributions: Designed and built the whole monorepo: VS Code extension, web workspace, shared agent-core, and local-runtime packages.
Implemented model discovery and management for local GGUF, Ollama, OpenAI-compatible, and cloud providers behind one interface.
Built the tool catalog with risk classes, tool search, orchestration, plan approval, diff review, and command confirmation.
Implemented specialised subagents, the agent loop with budgets and cancellation, SSE streaming, and the document, OCR, research, and artifact features of the web app.
Published and maintain the extension on the VS Code Marketplace.
